text:
elaine: NA1 hotpool alert — observed sustained p95/p99 token latency increase starting ~06:34 UTC, evictions spiked on a subset of GPUs. CPU looks fine. Disk io normal. KVCACHE mem pressure up.
ravi: seeing same on metrics. KVCACHE hitrate dropped from 87% -> 42% for recent 30m window. batch sizes jumped unexpectedly.
marta: any deploys around 06:30? CI shows a runtime change merged that touches continuous batching and kv cache eviction thresholds. @ravi can you link the commit?
ravi: commit: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/commit/17b4c2f — "reduce-kvcache-window". Deployed to NA1 rollout group at 06:28 by canary job.
sre-oncall: tagging incident. Pager: Sev2. Starting triage.
elaine: impact: user facing p99 latency up ~180-250ms for text generation. Hosted API error rate unchanged, just latency. Some customers on Dedicated report higher tail latencies when routed to NA1.
noah: suggests immediate mitigation: 1) divert traffic away from NA1 hotpool to NA2/NA3 for at-risk routes; 2) rollback that runtime change for NA1 hotpool; 3) temporarily increase hotpool size if needed. What order do we want?
marta: prefer rollback first then traffic shift. Rollback should restore kv cache behaviour — less risky than region-wide shift. But rollback takes ~6m to redeploy per node and needs rolling evict.
sre-oncall: we should do a small traffic shift to reduce pressure while rollback kicks in. 25% shift off NA1 -> NA2 for non-low-latency-restricted customers. Canary routing rules updated?
elaine: ok do: (A) apply routing override to move 25% non-SLA traffic off NA1 hotpool, (B) trigger runtime rollback to previous stable build on hotpool nodes, (C) monitor kv hitrate and tail latency.
ravi: running command to patch routing policy: ```/bin/rwctl route-update --region na1 --shift 25 --exclude-tags sla:lowlatency --reason "kvcache regression"```
infra-bot: deploy job queued: route-update/48291; estimated completion 45s.
noah: while that's running, start rollback playbook: ```./ops/rollback_runtime.sh --region na1 --pool hotpool --image runtime:2026-11-03-stable```
marta: note — rolling rollback will cause short-lived cold kv misses, expect temporary latency blips ~10-30s per node. Notify customers?
sre-oncall: doing health checks. Setting alert thresholds to 2x baseline to avoid noise.
infra-bot: route-update/48291 applied successfully. 25% traffic rerouted.
ravi: rollback started, patching 12 nodes in hotpool. Progress: 3/12 done.
elaine: post-shift metrics show p95 down 40ms already for the affected routes. Good sign. Keep going.
marta: rollback at 9/12. No errors so far. KV hitrate slowly climbing back.
sre-oncall: observed minor spike in backend tokens cost due to cache warm-up. Noted on cost channel.
noah: rollback completed 12/12. Can we restore routing gradually?avi: hold for 5m baseline after rollback completion to confirm p99 stable.
elaine: agreed. Monitoring p99, kv hitrate, batch size distribution. If stable for 5m, revert routing override.
(5m passes)
elaine: p99 back within 10ms of baseline, kv hitrate up to 84%. Batch sizes normalized.
sre-oncall: revert route-update to restore original distribution. ```/bin/rwctl route-update --region na1 --restore-defaults --reason "post-rollback stable"```
infra-bot: route-update/48292 applied. Traffic restored.
marta: creating incident ticket and starting postmortem. Action items: revert runtime change from branch unless further tests prove safe, add integration test covering kv eviction-window to catch regression, add automatic per-pool KVCACHE high-water alert.
elaine: add cost mitigation note: warm-up increased token ops ~5% during rollback; coordinate with finance for short spike.
sre-oncall: closing active pager. Will update when postmortem draft ready.
noah: thumbs: :thumbsup: Great run. Need to audit canary gating for config-only runtime changes.
elaine: thanks team. Will follow up in #postmortems with timeline and RCA.
